candidates.claim: Data from Oct 2025-Jan 2026. Claude intentionally limits its own independence by pausing to ask questions when uncertain — a built-in architectural constraint.
TRINITY is an evolved multi-agent coordination method that consistently outperforms existing multi-agent approaches and individual models across benchmarks.

Anthropic targets three unsolved production agent problems: memory degrades across sessions, output quality hard to enforce, and more. Claude limits its own independence by pausing to ask questions when uncertain.
Anthropic targets five primitives: rate-limit headroom, long-context architecture, retry-with-grader loops, memory consolidation, and agent event push — each addressing a known limitation.
2026 coding agent landscape is a three-way race: Anthropic Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, xAI Grok Build. Grok playing catch-up, Grok Build still in beta.
Sakana AI launched Fugu, a multi-agent orchestration system delivered as a single OpenAI-compatible model API. Fugu Ultra launched June 2026 priced at $5/M input, $30/M output.
Grok 4.20 mobile support is limited and user reports highlight inconsistency. Domain-specific limitations noted.
Grok main drawbacks: ecosystem dependency, less predictable business output, smaller integration network, trust concerns compared to competitors.
